# Rainbow Sprouts | Daycare, Playschool, Preschool & Tuitions

> Premier Early Education Center, Playschool, Preschool, Daycare & Tuition Center in Sector 10, Gurgaon (Haryana, India).

## About
Rainbow Sprouts is an early childhood educational institution and daycare center founded by Kamini Rajotia (B.Ed, TEFL certified, MBA, UGC-NET with 10+ years of teaching experience). It provides loving childcare, progressive playschool & preschool education, and structured after-school tuitions for children aged 1 to 10 years.

## Core Features & Safety
- **Live CCTV Access:** Secure mobile camera streaming provided to parents during all school & daycare hours.
- **Low Teacher-Child Ratio:** 1:8 dedicated ratio ensuring personalized care, safety, and focused attention.
- **Pediatric Nutrition:** Fresh, hygienic, home-cooked vegetarian meals prepared daily on-premise.
- **Verified Educators:** 100% police-verified, certified teachers and trained caregivers.
- **Modern Infrastructure:** Dedicated Montessori learning zones, indoor play gym, activity center, quiet sleeping rooms, and outdoor play space.

## Key Services & Programs
1. **Playschool & Playgroup (Ages 2 to 3 Years):**
   - Play-based social and cognitive foundation.
   - Sensory play, music, motor skill enhancement, and language development.
2. **Preschool & Nursery / Pre-school (Ages 3+ Years):**
   - Comprehensive pre-school curriculum with phonics, early numeracy, logical thinking, and reading readiness.
   - Smooth preparation for formal CBSE / ICSE / IB school admissions.
3. **Daycare Center (Full-Day & Half-Day, Ages 1+ Years):**
   - Flexible daycare timings from 8:30 AM to 7:00 PM.
   - Warm, secure home-away-from-home with live CCTV streaming for parents and balanced hot meals.
4. **Tuition Classes & After-School Coaching (Ages 3 to 10 Years):**
   - Personalized primary school tuitions and concept-clearing classes.
   - School homework support, handwriting improvement, reading comprehension, and mathematics.
   - Evening hobby and activity classes (art, craft, dance, and creative thinking).
